# keripy native-body fixture

`v2-basic-native.cesr` is a KEL (icp, rot, ixn) whose bodies are native CESR,
keripy's default kind, and `v2-basic-native.json` the key state keripy reached.
Both are copied unchanged from affinidi-keri-rs,
`crates/affinidi-keri-core/tests/fixtures/keripy-v2/`, where `gen.py` builds
them with keripy 2.1.0-dev1 (b70986f).
